title: adapted BASIC Tic-Tac-Toe (TICTACTOE2): flat goto label machine with numeric choice/move GETs, f-count AND-ladders, manual board printer and win/draw detector, value-mapped cells

console: DO YOU WANT X OR O ENTER 1 FOR X 2 FOR O 2
IT IS A DRAW. THANK YOU.

notes:
FC-01 OPERATOR OVERRIDE corpus, program 5 of 8 (Tic-Tac-Toe, BASIC).
BASE CHOICE (recorded): TICTACTOE2.bas (sha 9945f459...) - TICTACTOE1 (sha
e1125402...) was READ and REJECTED: on BOTH win and draw it executes GOTO 210 and
never terminates (its only stop would be GET-at-^Z-EOF, UNMEASURED), so no finite
complete stream can be derived from it.
ADAPTATION / DOCUMENTED UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE CHANGES (removal/substitution list):
(1) STRING CHOICE GET REPLACED BY A NUMERIC GET (declared): BASIC 500 INPUT C$
(1 = X, 2 = O) becomes `put list('DO YOU WANT X OR O ENTER 1 FOR X 2 FOR O '); get
list(c);` with 1 = X / 2 = O. CHARACTER console GET is UNMEASURED; the numeric
GET + echo laws are run-witnessed (HAMM-00, HANG-00).
(2) VALUE MAPPING (declared): board cell 1 = computer (BASIC -1), 2 = empty (BASIC
0), 3 = human (BASIC 1); the scan owner g is 1 on the computer pass and 3 on the
human pass, h its complement. Every compare therefore has a POSITIVE LITERAL or a
scalar on its right, because `= -1` and ordered compares against a VARIABLE right
operand are MEASURED refusals of my compiler (hop-3 probes shapes03/04/05; not DR
claims).
(3) THE AND-GATED BASIC IFs (106..109, 171..176, 1160, 1165) became f-count ladders
`f = 0; if t1 = a then f = f + 1; if t2 = b then f = f + 1; if f = 2 then goto L;`
with BOTH members re-loaded at every label (no stale-temp reuse).
(4) THE BASIC FOR LOOPS are flat goto loops: DO ... BY 3 is a MEASURED refusal, so
the row scan uses i = i + 3 with `if i < 8`, the column scan i = i + 1 with
`if i < 4`, the empty scan `if i < 10`, and the printer loop is manual (l1002..
l1080). Entry/loop-next labels are split (l1115n/l1150n/l1152n/l0177c) so a goto
never crosses an ACTIVE DO; the board-init `do i = 1 to 9; s(i) = 2; end;` is the
ONLY DO statement (LOOP.DO_TO_BY).
(5) m = 0 QUIT TEST via the measured shift idiom `t1 = m + 1; if t1 = 1 then` (a
compare against the literal 0 is refused); TAB() banner offsets (BASIC 20/30) are
dropped (no counted PUT - EDIT-00 measures the counted refusal).
(6) EQUIVALENCE ADAPTATION at BASIC 113/114/115: the three tests
3*INT((M-1)/3)+1/+2/+3 = M become `k = 1` at l0112 plus two scalar=scalar compares
(t2 = j + 1 = m, t3 = j + 2 = m). EQUIVALENT because j = 3*floor((m-1)/3)+1
satisfies j <= m <= j + 2 for every m in 1..9, so exactly ONE test can fire and the
default k = 1 IS the 113 test.
(7) EQUIVALENCE NOTE at l0112: `t1 = m - 1; t1 = t1 / 3;` relies on FIXED BIN(15)
division truncating TOWARD ZERO; m >= 1 there (l0502 exits on m = 0, l0503 refuses
m > 9, l0506 retries an occupied square), so truncation == BASIC INT() exactly. The
literal divisor 3 is fine (variable DIV is the MEASURED refusal, HAMM-00 rev1).
(8) APOSTROPHE REWRITE (declared): BASIC 1400 PRINT "IT'S A DRAW. THANK YOU." ->
'IT IS A DRAW. THANK YOU.' - no apostrophe may appear inside a literal in this
corpus (pinned corpus law); the message is otherwise unchanged.
(9) OCCUPIED MESSAGE FRAMING (MEASURED in the line-for-line audit): BASIC 506 is
message + TWO blanks and l500's leading PRINT adds the THIRD, so an occupied retry
emits `put list(...); put skip; put skip; put skip;`. An earlier model emitted only
two and was FALSIFIED; kept as written (PROTOCOL #2).
(10) THREE OCCUPIED MESSAGES on this script (moves 1, 10, 1 - normalized lines 86,
91, 96); the hop-4/hop-5 note of TWO is FALSIFIED and kept as written (PROTOCOL #2).
The game ends DRAW at l1400 after 8 GETs with the board 1,3,1,3,1,1,3,1,3.
(11) DEAD CODE KEPT FAITHFULLY (measured by the hop-4 exhaustive game-tree search -
never re-searched, see the hop-5 FAILURE LESSON): the HUMAN win (1200) is
UNREACHABLE in ANY play, so l0502t/l1180/l1200/l1350 and the diag dispatch are
never entered; l1112/l1137 ARE entered (an all-empty triple falls through them) but
their gotos never fire. Unreached labels on this script: l0475 (the X choice),
l0104, l0105, l0133, l0138, l0156, l0158, l0163, l0168, l0187, l0189, l0502t,
l1180, l1200, l1350; BASIC lines unreached: 104/105, 133/138, 156/158, 163/168,
187/189.
(12) FRAMING: the first executed PUT is a PUT LIST, so the stream starts with
TIC-TAC-TOE on line 1 (NO leading blank - unlike Batch-A/HANG/AMAZ); the final
'IT IS A DRAW. THANK YOU.' closes its line and the exit CRLF [C352] yields ONE
trailing blank line - 120 normalized lines, 1468 raw bytes.
(13) DERIVATION: expected.console is generated from reference.py:tict00, a
statement-for-statement mirror whose label dispatch was produced MECHANICALLY from
this pinned source (build/fc01-scratch/mk_tict00_mirror.py) and hand-checked, so the
unreached labels are mirrored too; it was diffed BYTE-EQUAL against the independent
port simulator build/fc01-scratch/tict00_sim.py (120/120 lines) BEFORE this JSON was
written, and the port itself was audited line-for-line against all 94 statements of
TICTACTOE2.bas. Never captured (L3).
(14) CAPABILITIES were grep-verified twice this hop: each id exists in
spec/COVERAGE.tsv with dr_status=ACCEPTS and mine_status=SUPPORTED, AND the
construct appears in TICT-00.PLI. AGG.VAR_INDEX_LADDER is KEPT (s(i), s(j), s(k),
s(m), s(b1/b2/b3) are variable-subscript references); LOOP.DO_TO_BY is the
board-init loop ONLY; EXPR.VARYING_X_VARYING and AGG.ELEM_AS_ACTUAL are DROPPED (no
varying compare, no array element passed as an actual).
(15) Lane-B RUN of this machine is UNWITNESSED until this spec executes; a FAIL stays
classified (my-gap / dr-refuses / unmeasured), never laundered.
